verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM ships its own desktop app and a web instance (hosted or self-hosted via Docker). Both carry features beyond chat: RAG over documents, agents, agent flows, local meeting transcription and multi-user workspaces. Hands-on users praise the polished single-install desktop packaging. However, nothing documents feature parity across these surfaces, and some features (e.g. local meeting transcription) appear tied to the desktop, so parity is unproven. Missing for 10: any official mobile app, explicit documentation of feature parity between desktop and web, independent corroboration of the web/hosted experience.
